title: Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC Buys 479,466 Shares of Apple (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Adam Dyson on Mar 19th, 2018 // No Comments 
Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.1% in the 3rd quarter, HoldingsChannel.com reports. The firm owned 12,109,070 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 479,466 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 2.0% of Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest holding. Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,866,250,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.

Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,651,000 after acquiring an additional 167,099 shares during the last quarter. Alley Co LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 1.1% in the second quarter. Alley Co LLC now owns 39,286 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,658,000 after acquiring an additional 437 shares during the last quarter. In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by insiders. Shares of Apple stock opened at $178.02 on Monday. Apple has a 52 week low of $138.62 and a 52 week high of $183.50. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The company has a market cap of $903,275.88, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.30, a PEG ratio of 1.34 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
A number of equities analysts have recently commented on AAPL shares. Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.70 price target on the stock. in a research report on Thursday, November 23rd. Nomura set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, November 27th. UBS set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, November 27th. Tigress Financial reissued a “strong-buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 6th. Finally, KeyCorp reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, December 7th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $201.53. 
About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
